why: a stocked home budgets its outposts' haul on the path its carriers walk, not the straight line: on gen 5 E9S9 took E9S8 at a straight 58 ticks whose haul walks ~120 out its north gap, so Economy cast half the far carriers it needed and the outposts' dig decayed while upgraders drew the stock (before the haul fix, c45a8705: its outposts decayed 31k from t18000 to t24000)
